step.cmd: Fact-find with the client and the employer. Refer to the Fact-Finding Guide and Digest 6 — Voluntary leaving employment to determine the questions to ask.
Determine if the client or employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client or employer was contacted, go to step 7.
If the client or employer was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 or Z-00-00-00 letter, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Reason for separation .
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
